context: A married couple debates a delayed honeymoon destination
purpose: Teach: 滋賀/チェコ/三重/北米/バルセロナ/トリノ/ボストン/サンフランシスコ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、遅れた新婚旅行、遂に行けそうよ。私はバルセロナのガウディが見たいの。
lines.en: Hey, our delayed honeymoon — we can finally go. I want to see Gaudi in Barcelona.
lines.style: Warm but firm wife opening the negotiation playfully.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いやぁ、バルセロナもいいけど、僕はずっとボストンの紅葉が見たいとおもってたんだよ。
lines.en: Well, Barcelona's nice, but I've been wanting to see Boston's autumn leaves for ages.
lines.style: Husband gently countering with his own long-held dream.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 北米もいいけど、ヨーロッパの空気を一口でも味わいたいの。チェコのプラハとかトリノとか。
lines.en: North America's fine, but I want even a taste of Europe's air — Prague in Czech, or Turin.
lines.style: Listing alternatives with a mildly insistent, dreamy tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うーん、君の長所は決断が早いところだなあ。でも予算の話、先制パンチで言っとくよ。
lines.en: Hmm, your strong point is deciding fast. But let me throw a preemptive punch about the budget.
lines.style: Teasing affectionately while raising the money concerns.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それなのに先月、あなたサンフランシスコ出張のついでに楽譜屋で散財してたじゃない。
lines.en: And yet last month, on your San Francisco business trip, you splurged at a sheet music shop.
lines.style: Playfully calling out his recent financial hypocrisy.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うっ、痛いところを…じゃあ妥協案。国内で滋賀の琵琶湖か、三重の伊勢神宮にしない?
lines.en: Ouch, you got me. Okay, a compromise — domestic, like Lake Biwa in Shiga or Ise Shrine in Mie?
lines.style: Retreating with a face-saving domestic counterproposal.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: しょっちゅう国内ばっかりじゃない。時折は遠出しないと、結婚した意味がないわ。
lines.en: It's always domestic. Without occasional far trips, there's no meaning in being married.
lines.style: Half-joking but pressing her point with mock pathos.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: じゃあ紳士協定だ。バルセロナ五日、僕の出番でトリノ二日。負債は来年のボーナスで可決ね。
lines.en: Gentleman's agreement — five days Barcelona, my turn two days Turin. The debt gets passed with next year's bonus.
lines.style: Mock-formal boardroom-style closing of the travel deal.
